snippet.title: The Horror of Blueberry Onsen | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The latest installment in the legendary mystery-solving #horrorgame  series “Ao oni” is now available on Nintendo Switch™ and Steam®!

The stage has changed from a Western-style house to an abandoned hot spring inn. 

Many new species of "Ao oni" appear in this title!
New elements include cooperative play with friends and a threatening 16x speed mode!


▼ Work Information 

Title: “Aooni The Horror of Blueberry Onsen” 
Genre: Mystery solving horror action adventure 
Release Models: Nintendo Switch™, PC (Steam®) 
Release Date: 
・Nintendo Switch™：April 25, 2025 
・Steam®：May 2, 2025
Language Support: Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, French, German Italian, Spanish, Indonesian, Italian, Spanish, Indonesian 

▼ For more information, please visit 

Nintendo Switch™:https://store-jp.nintendo.com/item/software/D70010000091842 
Steam®：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3388870/Aooni_The_Horror_of_Blueberry_Onsen/
